message: No agent-invocation-ledger.jsonl found in the plan directory. Review provenance relies on reviewer_invocation_id strings without ledger-backed evidence. The existing proof-plan-review.md uses reviewer_invocation_id 'proof-plan-reviewer-vb-jpq7-21-rerun-2026-06-04-gpt-5-5' but there is no matching agent-invocation row to independently verify the reviewer was not the same agent that wrote the plan.
required_fix: Create agent-invocation-ledger.jsonl with at least two rows: one for the proof-planner invocation and one for this proof-plan-reviewer invocation. Each row must have schema_version: agent-invocation/v1, independent invocation IDs, and matching input/output artifact hashes.
rationale: The plan's correctness is not dependent on the invocation ledger; it is a process improvement.
